meta.label: Sparse Gaussian process (SGPR, 500 inducing points, scoped features)

compute.notes: One thread (process_time). r0 652 s; r1 732 s; r2 724 s; r3 1266 s (hyperparameter + inducing-input optimisation with the collapsed bound on 20,000 rows, then the posterior over 200,000 rows). Shares the sim-train feature table of tab_gbm (7 s to build).

meta.feature_engineering: SCOPED subset (20 of tab_gbm's 47 daily features, feats.py, from the batch forcing + static vector only): P(t+1), P(t), liquid input W(t), W(t-1), melt(t) of a one-band degree-day snow proxy, EMAs of W over 3/10/30/90/365 days, two bucket fill fractions and spills, a 60-day slow store, EMA10 T, EMA30 PET, log1p SWE proxy, log aridity, snow fraction. Water features and target divided by p_mean; target transform z = sqrt(qo / p_mean). Inputs standardised with the training mean/sd.
